sn19.16:1.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ asīsakabandhaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ
sn19.16:1.2: tassa ure akkhīni ceva honti mukhañca
sn19.16:1.3: tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti
sn19.16:1.5: eso bhikkhave satto imasmiññeva rājagahe hāriko nāma coraghātako ahosi.
